headline: Contracts worth $250,000.00 and $446,949.85, the FY 2027 amended budget, and a union agreement on cyberattack bargaining.
summary: Six field trip requests from four schools are up for approval. The agenda also includes a 5-Year Budget Projection discussion and presentations on Multilingual and Exceptional Learners and 2025-2026 school year data.
items: Central High School same-day field trips to Shakespeare and Company in Lenox, MA, November 20 and 21, 2026
Putnam Vocational Technical Academy overnight trip to Skills USA Fall State Leadership Conference in Marlborough, MA, November 22-23, 2026
High School of Science and Technology overnight trip to Skills USA Fall State Leadership Conference in Marlborough, MA, November 22-23, 2026
Renaissance overnight trip to Red Gate Farm Education Center in Ashfield, MA, December 16-18, 2026
Central High School overnight trip to Air Force JROTC Open Drill Nationals in Dayton, OH, March 4-7, 2027
Putnam Vocational Technical Academy overnight trip to Skills USA State Leadership and Skills Conference in Marlborough, MA, April 29-May 1, 2027
Notice of Exercise of Renewal Option No. 1 for City Contract No. 20260209, McKinney-Vento school transportation with King Gray Coach Lines, $250,000.00
Amendment No. 6 for City Contract No. 20150011, Hampden County Sheriff's Department agreement, $446,949.85
Ratify Memorandum of Agreement with Springfield Education Association on impact bargaining regarding cyberattack, through March 31, 2027
Process and timeline for the Superintendent's evaluation
Report from student representative Zulmarie Layne
Presentation on Multilingual and Exceptional Learners
Presentation on Good News from a Great Place: 2025-2026 School Year Data and Celebrations

ORDER OF BUSINESS

I. CALL TO ORDER – REGULAR MEETING – ROLL CALL 
A. Invocation 
B. Pledge of Allegiance 
II. APPROVAL OF MINUTES: 
A. Vote to approve the Minutes of the School Committee’s Regular Meeting on 
September 24, 2026. 
B. Vote to approve the Minutes of the School Committee’s Regular Meeting on October 8, 
2026. 
C. Vote to approve the Minutes of the School Committee’s Special Meeting on October 
22, 2026. 
D. Vote to approve the Minutes of the School Committee’s Town Hall on October 22, 
2026. 
III. VOTING ITEMS: 
A. Vote to approve Central High School’s same day field trip requests to Shakespeare and 
Company in Lenox, MA on November 20, 2026, and November 21, 2026. 
B. Vote to approve Putnam Vocational Technical Academy’s overnight field trip request
2 of 3 
Regular Meeting of the Springfield School Committee  
to the Massachusetts Skills USA Fall State Leadership Conference in Marlborough, 
MA leaving on November 22, 2026, and returning November 23, 2026. 
C. Vote to approve the High School of Science and Technology’s overnight field trip 
request to the Massachusetts Skills USA Fall State Leadership Conference in 
Marlborough, MA leaving on November 22, 2026, and returning November 23, 2026. 
D. Vote to approve Renaissance’s overnight field trip request to Red Gate Farm Education 
Center in Ashfield, MA leaving on December 16, 2026, and returning December 18, 
2026. 
E. Vote to approve Central High Schools’s overnight field trip request to the Air Force 
JROTC Open Drill Nationals in Dayton, OH leaving on March 4, 2027, and returning 
March 7, 2027. 
F. Vote to approve Putnam Vocational Technical Academy’s overnight field trip request 
to the Massachusetts Skills USA State Leadership and Skills Conference in 
Marlborough, MA leaving on April 29, 2027, and returning May 1, 2027. 
G. Vote to approve the Notice of Exercise of Renewal Option No. 1 for City Contract No. 
20260209, Blanket Agreement to Share Costs of McKinney-Vento School 
Transportation Between the City of Springfield, MA Acting by and through the 
Springfield Public Schools, and other School Districts, using King Gray Coach Lines, 
in the amount of $250,000.00. 
H. Vote to approve Amendment No. 6 for City Contract No. 20150011, Inter-
Governmental Agency Agreement Between the City of Springfield and the Hampden 
Country Sheriff's Department, in the amount of $446,949.85. 
I. Vote to approve the FY 2027 Amended Budget. 
J. Vote to ratify the Memorandum of Agreement between the Springfield School 
Committee and the Springfield Education Association, MTA/NEA for the period from 
signing of the Memorandum of Agreement through March 31, 2027, on the subject of 
Impact Bargaining Regarding Cyberattack. 
K. Vote to approve the process and timeline for the Superintendent's evaluation. 
IV. REPORT OF THE STUDENT REPRESENTATIVE: 
A. Zulmarie Layne, Senior at Springfield Virtual School.
